name: 热带雨林
era: 赤道两侧 · 终年高温多雨
oneLiner: 物种最丰富的陆地生态系统，分层结构复杂，是地球的碳汇与生物多样性热点。
oneLinerEn: The most species-rich terrestrial ecosystem, with layered structure—Earth's carbon sink and biodiversity hotspot.

positions.v: 乔木层 / 林下层 / 地被
占全球一半以上陆地物种

why: 固碳、调节气候、提供药物与基因资源；其消失会放大全球变暖与物种灭绝。
whyEn: Stores carbon, stabilizes climate, supplies medicines; its loss amplifies warming and extinction.

name: 珊瑚礁
era: 浅海热带 · 清澈温暖
oneLiner: 珊瑚虫与虫黄藻共生建成的海底结构，单位面积生物多样性最高的生态系统之一。
oneLinerEn: Structures built by corals and their algal symbionts—among the most biodiverse ecosystems per area.

positions.v: 珊瑚虫 × 虫黄藻共生

why: 支撑渔业与海岸防护；对海水升温敏感，白化事件频发警示海洋健康。
whyEn: Supports fisheries and coastal protection; heat-driven bleaching signals ocean health.

name: 温带落叶林
oneLiner: 以冬季落叶的阔叶乔木为主，季节变化明显，是重要的碳库与木材来源。
oneLinerEn: Dominantly winter-deciduous broadleaves with strong seasons; a key carbon stock and timber source.

positions.vEn: E Asia, E N America, Europe

why: 调节水文与碳循环，为大量鸟类与哺乳动物提供栖息地。
whyEn: Buffers water and carbon cycles and shelters many birds and mammals.

name: 草原
oneLiner: 以草本植物为主、树木稀疏的生态系统，支撑大型草食动物与捕食者，土壤肥沃。
oneLinerEn: Herb-dominated, tree-sparse ecosystems supporting large grazers and predators on fertile soils.
why: 全球重要粮仓与牧场，土壤有机碳储量巨大，但对开垦与干旱敏感。
whyEn: Major breadbasket and rangeland with huge soil carbon, yet sensitive to plowing and drought.

name: 荒漠
oneLiner: 年降水量极低的生态系统，生物以耐旱适应（肉质、CAM 光合、夜行）生存，生态脆弱。
oneLinerEn: Ecosystems with minimal rainfall where life survives via succulence, CAM photosynthesis and nocturnality—ecologically fragile.

positions.v: 副热带高压带与雨影区

why: 提醒水资源约束；荒漠化扩张威胁生计，但物种演化出惊人适应。
whyEn: Highlights water limits; desertification threatens livelihoods, yet species show astonishing adaptation.

name: 苔原
era: 极地 / 高山 · 低温
oneLiner: 低温、生长季短、地下为永久冻土的生态系统，植被低矮，却封存着巨量有机碳。
oneLinerEn: Cold, short-season ecosystems over permafrost with low vegetation that lock away enormous organic carbon.
why: 冻土碳库对气候反馈敏感，融化可能加速变暖，是气候临界点之一。
whyEn: Its frozen carbon is climate-sensitive; thawing could accelerate warming—a tipping point.

name: 深海
oneLiner: 阳光无法到达、高压低温的海洋底层与热液口，生命依靠化能合成而非光合作用。
oneLinerEn: Sunless, high-pressure, cold ocean depths and vents where life runs on chemosynthesis, not sunlight.

positions.v: 化能合成（热液 / 冷泉）

why: 占地球宜居体积大部分，可能藏着生命起源线索与未知物种。
whyEn: Most of Earth's habitable volume; may hold origin-of-life clues and unknown species.

name: 湿地
era: 水陆交错 · 周期淹没
oneLiner: 介于陆地与水域之间的生态系统（沼泽、红树林、河口），净化水质、蓄洪并养育候鸟。
oneLinerEn: Ecosystems between land and water (marshes, mangroves, estuaries) that clean water, buffer floods and feed migratory birds.

positions.v: 沼泽 / 红树林 / 河口

why: 单位面积固碳能力极强，却因填海造地消失最快，保护优先级高。
whyEn: Among the highest carbon sinks yet disappearing fastest to land reclamation—high protection priority.
